d: As Diwali and Chhath Puja approach, migrant workers traveling home face severe overcrowding on Indian trains despite special services run by the government. Limited general coaches force laborers into packed compartments where people sit in bathrooms, creating major difficulties for women, children and the elderly needing restroom access, while TTEs often demand extra money. Many cannot afford sleeper or AC tickets and must rely on general class. In Surat, Gujarat, workers have launched the Gaon Chalo Andolan demanding weekly offs and reduced 8-hour shifts instead of 12-hour duties,…
